VBO:0201292.summary: Calm and cheerful in her foster home, thirteen-year-old Bella illustrates one Oldies Club account of a Sprollie. She settled within a day after a sudden move from her previous home and liked resting beside her carer’s desk. Walks, garden pottering and staying close to people were favorite parts of her routine. The rescue described her as a Spaniel–Collie cross.
VBO:0201292.shortDescription: Bella’s foster carers described a calm, cheerful thirteen-year-old Sprollie who enjoyed walks and stayed close to people.
